items.title: Sections of a constant tensor product: \underline{M \otimes_\Lambda Q}(U) = \underline{M}(U) \otimes_\Lambda Q for finitely presented Q
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The proof runs a presentation argument: choose a finite presentation \Lambda^{\oplus m} \to \Lambda^{\oplus n} \to Q \to 0, tensor with M to get an exact sequence, apply the exactness of the underline construction on exact sequences of constant modules (lemma-constant-exact, proved earlier in this chapter), and read off the equality of section functors; the finiteness of the presentation is exactly what lets the last step land in finite direct sums, to which taking sections over U commutes. The bookkeeping of which direct sums stay finite is the substance.
